title: Companion personal-quest threads (Tamsin's Cinderhall/mine grief, Lys's brother at Camp Gallows) are silently locked out the moment you cross the Pass Gate toward Marrowgate ('A companion's grief left unfinished there stays unfinished unless you walk back for it'), but nothing earlier in the game signals how large the map is relative to how much an Envoy can realistically cover with a full four-person party before that gate closes — both threads were confirmed abandoned in the final epilogue ('Tamsin never got to Cinderhall with you'; 'Lys walked with you to the end with her brother's name still unspoken').
